description: [WALK · internal] Bring a situation in your own words; receive the ONE of Christ's parables whose SHAPE fits it — the story verbatim (the Prodigal Son, the Good Samaritan, the Talents, the Sower, Luke 15 / Matthew 13 / Matthew 25 ...), his OWN explanation where he gave one, and one next step. The WALK door's final register: a story you walk into and find yourself inside. Found and cited, never generated; honest silence where no single parable fits (not every situation has one story).

text.description: the situation, in your own words
